frequency_question: What proportion of scheduled policy meetings result in a formal rate hike announcement?
membership_rule: Includes all regular and unscheduled monetary policy committee decisions explicitly altering the repo or main policy rate upwards; excludes mere liquidity adjustments, reserve requirement changes without repo rate changes, and verbal guidance without a formal committee resolution.
coverage_note: 12 consecutive scheduled meetings analyzed from the most recent complete tightening and transition cycle.
known_gaps: Excludes unscheduled inter-meeting emergency announcements, though these are historically rare for this institution.
skeleton: Recent multi-year rate-setting cycle comprising 12 sequential scheduled MPC meetings covering tightening and pause phases.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 12 scheduled meetings in the sampled reference cycle.
validity_reason: Monetary policy reaction functions typically remain stable across multi-year inflation regimes before structural mandate shifts occur.
